title: Territory Manager
description: Job Description: Per l’area terapeutica Gastroenterologica e Pediatrica stiamo ricercando la figura di un Territory Manager/Territory Specialist. La tua sfida Grazie a un approccio strategico, basato su dati, insight di mercato e una profonda conoscenza del contesto competitivo, guiderai lo sviluppo del territorio assegnato, individuando nuove opportunità e definendo, insieme all'Area Manager, le priorità per massimizzarne il potenziale. Sarai il partner di riferimento per professionisti sanitari, Key Opinion Leader e di tutti gli stakeholder rilevanti, costruendo relazioni di fiducia e partnership durature. Attraverso una solida competenza scientifica, promuoverai il valore del portfolio prodotti e supporterai l'adozione di soluzioni in grado di migliorare la pratica clinica e il percorso di cura dei pazienti. Lavorerai con elevata autonomia, pianificando e gestendo le attività del territorio in stretta collaborazione con i team Marketing, Medical Affairs e le altre funzioni aziendali. Il tuo ruolo Promuovere il valore scientifico del portfolio prodotti e supportare l'adozione di soluzioni terapeutiche innovative mediante attività di informazione scientifica; Gestire strategicamente il territorio assegnato, con piena responsabilità dello sviluppo dell’area e del raggiungimento degli obiettivi Definire ed eseguire piani territoriali e account plan basati su dati di mercato e dati clinici insight di mercato e analisi delle performance, identificando nuove opportunità di crescita; Sviluppare e consolidare relazioni di lungo periodo con l'intero ecosistema di stakeholder; Monitorare il mercato, le dinamiche competitive e i competitor, trasformando gli insight raccolti in strategie efficaci; Collaborare con team cross-funzionali (Medical Affairs, Marketing, KAM, Customer Service e Regolatorio) per garantire un'esecuzione coordinata delle strategie aziendali; Gestire forecasting, CRM, reporting e KPI, assicurando un'elevata qualità dell'esecuzione e una pianificazione efficace; Rappresentare l'azienda durante congressi, eventi scientifici e iniziative formative, contribuendo al rafforzamento del posizionamento aziendale come partner di riferimento e alla creazione di valore sostenibile sul territorio. Hai il profilo giusto se Hai una laurea in discipline scientifiche e possiedi i requisiti previsti dal D.Lgs. 219/2006 per lo svolgimento dell'attività di Informazione Medico-Scientifica; Solida conoscenza del contesto sanitario, delle dinamiche di mercato e dei principali stakeholder, costituisce un plus se hai già conoscenza nelle aree terapeutiche di riferimento gastroenterologia, pediatria, chirurgia; Eccellenti doti relazionali, comunicative e negoziali, con un approccio orientato alla creazione di partnership di lungo periodo; Esperienza a lavorare per obiettivi, monitorando KPI e risultati attraverso strumenti di CRM e reporting; Esperienza nella collaborazione con team cross-funzionali; Spirito d'iniziativa, autonomia decisionale e capacità di definire le priorità in un contesto in continua evoluzione. Perché unirti a noi Entrerai a far parte di un'azienda internazionale, guidata dall'innovazione scientifica e dall'impegno concreto nel migliorare la qualità di vita dei pazienti. Investiremo nella tua crescita attraverso la possibilità di partecipare a programmi di formazione continua dedicati alle competenze tecniche, alle soft skills e allo sviluppo linguistico a supporto della crescita professionale e personale. Troverai un ambiente di lavoro fondato sui nostri principi ACE – Accountability, Collaboration ed Entrepreneurship, che incoraggia spirito d'iniziativa, collaborazione trasversale, orientamento ai risultati e assunzione di responsabilità. Contratto di lavoro a tempo indeterminato con inquadramento al livello B1 (CCNL Chimico-Farmaceutico – Impiegati). Il pacchetto retributivo prevede una retribuzione annua lorda a partire da €45.000, unitamente ad un sistema incentivi e benefit aziendali. La retribuzione, così come il job title come Territory Manager o Territory Specialist, saranno da definire in funzione dell'esperienza maturata, della conoscenza dell'area terapeutica e delle competenze e qualifiche del candidato. Territorio di competenza: Friuli-Venezia Giulia, Trentino-Alto Adige e le province di Treviso, Venezia e Belluno. Location: Ferring Italy

title: Sales Representative, Reproductive Medicine - Gulf Coast
description: Job Description: As a privately- owned, biopharmaceutical company, Ferring pioneers and delivers life-changing therapies that help people build families and live better lives. Our independence helps us cultivate an entrepreneurial spirit and long-term perspective that enables us to achieve growth and scale, while remaining agile and true to our ‘people first’ philosophy. Built on a 70-year plus commitment to science and research, Ferring is relentless in its pursuit of science that drives powerful discoveries and therapies to help people build families, stay healthy, and stand up to the world’s oldest enemy: disease. As the Sales Representative, Reproductive Medicine and Maternal Health you will be responsible for all sales activities in an assigned geographical area. Achieve maximum sales volume through promotion of Ferring Products to physicians, advanced practice providers, pharmacists, clinic staff. With Ferring, you will be joining a recognized leader, identified as one of “The World’s Most Innovative Companies” by Fast Company, and honored by Fortune with inclusion on its “Change the World List,” for addressing society’s unmet needs. Complex Market Understanding. Experience in customer generation and development. Excellent communication and written skills. Excellent problem-solving skills. Strong analytical skills. Travel required to perform sales duties. Demonstrated track record in sales. Must live in the territory. Clear Background Check. title: MTS Data Analyst
description: Job Description: MTS Data Analyst At Ferring Pharmaceuticals, we help people around the world build families and live better lifes. We are entrepreneurial and innovative, with a global team focused on scientific advances in the areas of reproductive and women’s health, gastroenterology and urology. Ferring + You is all about working together and sharing ideas, so that we can bring science to life for patients around the world. Our Technical Operations division develops, manufactures and supplies high-quality products so our patients can live better lives. Creating and delivering life-changing products means getting it right first time is a shared responsibility, so our global manufacturing teams work closely together to ensure quality, accuracy and safety at all times. That means a culture of empowerment, where speaking up is valued, and growth and development are constant. Ferring+You You will be an integral part of the team responsible for driving processes robustness in the Manufacturing Technology and Science (MTS) and for leading data analysis to create business cases and investigation. The team is at the forefront of managing performance across 15 manufacturing sites worldwide and leads cross-functional projects aimed at enhancing the overall network performance. As a Data Analyst in our pharmaceutical environment, you will play a key role in transforming operational and quality data into actionable insights. You will assess and prioritize department data needs, design and maintain a scalable Power BI reporting landscape, and automate data reporting to improve performance, decision-making, and continuous improvement across our network. Your day at Ferring In this context, you will play a critical role in: Assess and prioritize Technical Operations departments data needs: Assess department data needs, evaluate existing data sources, and translate requirements into a prioritized analytics backlog. Build & maintain Power BI reporting: Develop, publish, and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports (data modeling, DAX measures, performance optimization, UX). Standardize Power BI landscape: Contribute to Power BI governance and harmonization across sites/functions (common KPIs, templates, certified datasets, documentation). Data Visualization and Analysis: Develop compelling data visualizations and analysis to support TechOps strategy, translating complex data into actionable insights. Build business cases and support investigation by leveraging Ferring’s data. Automate reporting: Automate refresh, distribution, and recurring reporting processes to reduce manual effort and improve reliability. Drive continuous improvement: Identify reporting/process improvement opportunities, track adoption, and measure impact. Ensure compliance & data integrity: Apply access control, traceability, and data integrity expectations appropriate for a regulated environment. This role presents a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in working in a dynamic pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. You will also have the opportunity to with our data analysis team to translate data into business insights. Behind our innovation…There’s you To carry-out these tasks you will be expected to quickly adapt to the Ferring data management and new tools such as Power BI. You will be given an important autonomy to come up with design and improvement ideas but will be guided and supported by the team every step of the way. You need to be: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Analytics, Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or equivalent experience. Proven experience building and maintaining Power BI dashboards in an operational environment (manufacturing, supply chain, quality, regulated industry preferred). Strong skills in data modeling , DAX , Power Query , and dashboard performance optimization. Good working knowledge of SQL (required); experience with data platforms (e.g., Azure, Snowflake, Databricks) is a plus. Strong analytical thinking, structured problem solving, and attention to detail. Storytelling with data: ability to simplify complex topics and influence decisions. Ownership mindset: proactive, hands-on, and delivery-focused. People come first at Ferring Get inspired from our commitment to advocate for everyone’s right to build a family, no matter who you are, where you live or who you love Our inclusive support package – “Building Families at Ferring” provides equal and accessible policies for all employees who wish to start their family journey, ensuring a global standard, irrespective of location and role Parental leave for both birthing and non-birthing parents Extended support on family building journey Making a difference in the life of millions of people means we succeed by working together. Our diverse backgrounds, experiences, expertise, and perspectives enable us to find solutions to even the most challenging problems, and our success is tied to each team member’s contributions. Imagine the power of your career when it’s Ferring + You. Behind our purpose… There’s you If our mission and your vision are aligned, please apply! We strive to build and maintain an inclusive and diverse workplace with equal opportunities and mutual respect for all employees regardless of their backgrounds and socioeconomic status. Location: Ferring Service Center Portugal
